items.title: The D-Wave Quantum Bet: How an Expanded AT&T Deal Is Boosting the Stock
items.summary: In the quantum space, commercial traction is often the strongest signal of progress.  The quantum developer unveiled an expanded partnership with  AT&T  on Monday to deploy its signature annealing systems.  AT&T isn’t a new collaborator; D-Wave first teased the relationship earlier this year, when representatives from the telecom giant appeared at D-Wave’s annual user conference.
